title: Held-out sequence models
summary: Fit finite n-gram models and report held-out cross-entropy and parameter count.
assumptions: Training and test partitions are separated before fitting.
controls: Equal tuning budgets; simpler baselines; out-of-quire evaluation.

cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.
